image_description: A small, disc-shaped marine fish identified as a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor) resting on a textured coral surface. The fish displays the characteristic coloration pattern with a black anterior head and upper body, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. The eye is prominent with a light blue iris. The background consists of out-of-focus reef structures.
